title: Asian stocks surge as Micron earnings ease AI fears
title_zh: 美光科技盈利缓解人工智能担忧，亚洲股市飙升
summary: By Ankur Banerjee SINGAPORE, June 25 (Reuters) - Asian equities surged on Thursday after strong earnings and forecasts from chip giants Micron and Qualcomm helped alleviate some concerns over the red-
summary_zh: 路透新加坡 6 月 25 日 - 芯片巨头美光科技 (Micron) 和高通 (Qualcomm) 的强劲盈利和预测帮助缓解了人们对红色的担忧，周四亚洲股市飙升。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise as Micron, Qualcomm ease AI jitters
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货上涨，美光、高通缓解了人工智能的不安
summary: US stock futures rose as Micron and Qualcomm helped boost confidence in the AI trade following several tough days for tech stocks.
summary_zh: 在科技股经历了数个艰难的日子后，美光和高通帮助提振了人们对人工智能行业的信心，美国股指期货上涨。

title: Qualcomm jumps as it looks beyond smartphones to cash in on the AI boom
title_zh: 高通公司将目光投向智能手机以外的领域，从人工智能热潮中获利
summary: Qualcomm doubles its non-handset revenue outlook for fiscal 2029.
summary_zh: 高通将 2029 财年非手机收入预期提高了一倍。

title: Trading Day: Tech jitters smother inflation relief
title_zh: 交易日：科技紧张情绪抑制通胀缓解
summary: By Jamie McGeever ORLANDO, Florida, June 24 (Reuters) - U.S. bond yields tumbled on Wednesday as oil's slide to a four-month low eased inflation fears, although the relief wasn't felt as much in
summary_zh: 佛罗里达州奥兰多，6 月 24 日（路透社） - 由于油价跌至四个月低点缓解了通胀担忧，美国债券收益率周三暴跌，尽管美国债券收益率并未得到太大缓解。

title: Strategist explains balance the market is looking for at end of first half 2026
title_zh: 策略师解释市场在 2026 年上半年末寻求的平衡
summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) are a mixed bag at Wednesday's session close coming off of yesterday's Big Tech sell-off.
summary_zh: 美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）在周三收盘时因昨天大型科技股的抛售而涨跌互现。

title: The CBOE moves into prediction market space
title_zh: CBOE 进入预测市场空间
summary: Scott Melker breaks down the Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) move into prediction markets and what it means for the rapidly growing space. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.
summary_zh: 斯科特·梅尔克 (Scott Melker) 详细介绍了芝加哥期权交易所 (CBOE) 进入预测市场的举措，以及这对快速增长的领域意味着什么。 《The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker》每天中午 12:00 播出。请关注您每天对加密事物的了解。

title: Qualcomm debuts line of AI data center chips and systems, increasing competition with Nvidia
title_zh: 高通推出人工智能数据中心芯片和系统系列，加剧与英伟达的竞争
summary: Qualcomm is increasing its line of AI data center products as it looks to grow its share of the market.
summary_zh: 为了扩大市场份额，高通正在增加其人工智能数据中心产品线。

title: Alphabet makes the Dow look more like the Nasdaq
title_zh: Alphabet 让道琼斯指数看起来更像纳斯达克指数
summary: Alphabet's inclusion in the Dow gives the 130-year-old blue-chip index a dose of the same mega-cap tech trade already dominating the Nasdaq 100.
summary_zh: Alphabet 被纳入道琼斯指数，为这个拥有 130 年历史的蓝筹股指数带来了与已经在纳斯达克 100 指数中占据主导地位的大型科技股一样的机会。

title: Analysis-Apple-Intel chip deal makes strategic sense but production is years away
title_zh: 分析：苹果与英特尔的芯片交易具有战略意义，但量产还需要数年时间
summary: Apple turning to Intel for chips, as Washington announced last week, has the neat logic of necessity meeting ambition.
summary_zh: 正如华盛顿上周宣布的那样，苹果公司转向英特尔购买芯片，其逻辑是为了满足雄心壮志。
